signZones.cite: opcodes.md §4.1 / charset.md §6 / architecture.md §10 — A22-0526-3 p.16 Figure 11
signZones.note: The sign of a field is the zone bits of its UNITS (rightmost) position. Minus is ALWAYS a B bit alone; every other zone combination is plus.

written.cite: architecture.md §10 / charset.md §6 — 'When the machine generates or changes a sign it writes B+A for plus, B for minus'

digitCoding.note: Characters whose numeric bits are a digit 0-9 are used at face value; every other character is coerced by DROPPING THE 8 BIT. The numeric portion 8-2 is the code for the digit ZERO in this character set (charset.md §2 rank 54: '0' is octal 12), so it is face value 0 and not 'ten'. A character with no numeric bits at all — blank, '&', '-', substitute blank — is zero.

addCycle.cite: opcodes.md §4.3 — A22-0526-3 p.16 Figure 12 'Add-cycle selection and result sign'
addCycle.note: Subtract inverts the A-field sign FIRST, then the Add rule applies; the rows below are the printed figure, one per (operation, A sign, B sign). 'greater' means the sign of the greater value, which the hardware resolves by the carry out of the high-order position: a carry means B was the greater and its sign stands; no carry means A was the greater, a RECOMPLEMENT pass is taken and A's sign is written.
addCycle.recomplement: When a complement-add underflows (no carry out of the high-order position) a recomplement pass is taken; the timing term R is 1 when a recomplement occurs (the +1.5RB of 4.5(L+1+E+A+1.5B+1.5RB)). opcodes.md §4.3, §1.5.
